bends.note: the 60' avenue ends at a closing line at y~3310 (by the Fairview Heights Inclined Plane station); south of it only a single west line (labelled 25') runs SSW to the 20' street, starting at the avenue's centre; the 25' strip's east side is open land. Centreline jogs ~100 px east here
Emming comes in from the WNW at ~20 deg (sheet 236) and turns due east at Freeman's east line

notes: Two different '?' streets, both left unnamed as on sheet 236: (1) the ~19' street entering from the top edge at x~890-1000 and ending at Warner (236's 'Warner | ?' T); Warner is 40' west of it and 50' east of it. (2) the 20' street (lines y~4150/4302) running from the left edge to the right edge between Warner and Emming (236's 20' street from McMicken); east of Fairview its north side is open land (only the south line is drawn). Fairview Av (60', printed FAIRVIEW AV.) crosses Warner (continues north onto 249) and runs SSW; its 25' tail meets the 20' street; the T point is on the assumed centre of the 25' strip (12.5' east of the drawn line), so it is less certain than the rest. Printed names: WARNER (written 'Warner Street' as instructed; sheet 236 wrote 'Warner'), EMMING (written 'Emming' as on 236), CONROY ('Conroy Street' as on 236), KLOTTER AV., BROWNE ALLEY, BAYMILLER ('Baymiller Street' as on 227), FREEMAN AV., W. McMICKEN. Freeman Av starts at Emming (T). Conroy is 10' west of Freeman (slanting at ~20 deg) and 20' east of it; the Conroy point is the middle of the open crossing. Browne Alley ends at Freeman (west block line continuous). Baymiller (50', leaning ~8 deg) starts at Conroy: Conroy's north line is continuous across Baymiller's head, so Baymiller/Conroy is a T. Klotter and Browne Alley continue east of Baymiller onto 227 (crosses). Emming and the 20' street run off the right edge onto 238. The inclined plane railroad and the A-B boundary line are not streets.
